summary.label: ML stock ranker (H34 development), 2023-2025
summary.note: LightGBM walk-forward: each year predicted by a model trained only on earlier years (from 2021). Ranks stocks vs the day's average; top 2 a day, long or short, only when the predicted lead beats 2x charges; 3% stop, 15:10 exit. Development trial 2.
